name: Vancouver Institute of Media Arts
rank: Ranked among the Top 25 International Animation Schools by Animation Career Review (year varies by annual publication); recognized in The Rookies' Top Schools rankings for creative media and entertainment programmes (specific annual position varies). These are verified ranking sources that have cited VanArts in published lists. Exact numerical positions and years should be confirmed directly via animationcareerreview.com and throokies.com for the most current edition.

Programme-specific requirements apply: most programmes require a portfolio submission demonstrating relevant creative aptitude, a personal statement or statement of intent, and may include an interview. English-language proficiency is required for non-native speakers, commonly demonstrated via IELTS (typically 6.0 overall or equivalent) or TOEFL. VanArts is a private post-secondary institution registered with the Private Training Institutions Branch (PTIB) of British Columbia. Acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed. Specific requirements should be confirmed at https://www.vanarts.com/admissions/.
cost_shape: Tuition varies by programme. Based on information available on the VanArts official website, one-year diploma programmes are approximately CAD 20,000–28,000 per academic year for both domestic and international students, with some variation by programme (e.g., Animation, Game Art, Acting, Broadcasting). International students may face additional fees. These figures should be verified directly at https://www.vanarts.com/tuition-fees/ as fees are updated annually.
contact: Admissions contact available at: https://www.vanarts.com/contact/ | Phone (published on official site): 1-604-682-2787 | Email: info@vanarts.com

name: Vancouver Film School
rank: Ranked among the Top 25 Animation Schools in the World and Top 10 in Canada by Animation Career Review (cited in multiple years including 2022–2024); listed among top global film and game design schools by The Rookies (Game Design and Animation categories, various years). Estimate: VFS is broadly regarded as one of Canada's most prominent private film and digital media schools; this reflects institutional reputation, alumni industry presence, and programme recognition, not a single verified numerical global ranking across all programmes.
entry: VFS offers one-year intensive diploma and certificate programmes. General admission requirements include: completion of secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) or mature student status; a personal statement or statement of intent; programme-specific portfolio, demo reel, or creative submission (required for programmes such as Film Production, Animation, Game Design, Acting, and others); an interview may be required for select programmes. English-language proficiency is required for non-native speakers, typically demonstrated via IELTS (overall band 6.0 or equivalent) or TOEFL. No standardised academic entrance examination (e.g. SAT) is required. Acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed. Specific requirements vary by programme; applicants are encouraged to consult the official admissions page for programme-specific details.
cost_shape: Tuition varies by programme. As of the 2023–2024 academic year, VFS one-year diploma programmes range from approximately CAD 21,000 to CAD 42,000 depending on the programme (e.g. Film Production and Acting for Film and Television are among the higher-cost programmes). These figures apply to both domestic and international students, as VFS generally does not differentiate tuition by student origin. Total cost of attendance including accommodation, living expenses, and materials will be higher. Figures sourced from VFS published programme fee schedules; prospective students should verify current fees directly with the institution as fees are updated annually.
contact: Admissions contact via official website: https://vfs.edu/admissions; general enquiries and admissions phone: +1 604-685-5808; admissions email: admissions@vfs.edu (listed on official VFS website).

name: Thakur College of Engineering and Technology
rank: NIRF Innovation Ranking (2023): Band 151–300; India Today Engineering Ranking (2023): Ranked 68 among private engineering colleges in India; Outlook-ICARE India Rankings (2023): Ranked 43 among Top 160 Private Engineering Institutes.
entry: Undergraduate (B.E./B.Tech) admission requires 10+2 (HSC) with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects, obtaining at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories), plus a valid score in MHT-CET or JEE Main via the Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell (CAP) counselling; Postgraduate (M.E.) requires a relevant Bachelor's degree and a valid GATE score; acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. INR 1,40,000–1,60,000 per year for undergraduate (B.E./B.Tech) programmes for domestic students, subject to annual revision by the Fees Regulating Authority (FRA), Maharashtra.

name: Fundação Hermínio Ometto
rank: Evaluated with an institutional concept (CI) and General Course Index (IGC) score of 4 out of 5 by the Brazilian Ministry of Education (MEC).
entry: Admission is primarily based on the institutional entrance examination (Vestibular FHO), National High School Exam (ENEM) scores, or direct transfer/second-degree processes; completion of secondary education (Ensino Médio) is required.
cost_shape: Approx. BRL 8,000–30,000 per year depending on the undergraduate programme, with scholarships and financing available (such as Prouni, FIES, and PAG/FHO).

name: Antonio Nariño University
rank: QS Latin America & The Caribbean University Rankings 2024: 251-300; SCImago Institutions Rankings 2023: ranked 12th nationally in Colombia for research output; Times Higher Education Latin America University Rankings 2023: Reporter status.
entry: Completion of secondary education (Bachiller diploma), results from the national state exam Saber 11 (ICFES), copy of identity document, and completed application form; certain specialized programs (such as Medicine, Dentistry, or Arts) may require an interview or program-specific test. Acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. COP 4,000,000 to COP 26,000,000 per semester depending on the program (with Medicine at the higher end and social sciences/engineering generally ranging between COP 4,500,000 and COP 8,500,000 per semester).

name: Engineering Institute of Technology
rank: Ranked #1 in Australia for undergraduate engineering student experience and overall quality of educational experience in the Australian Government's Quality Indicators for Learning and Teaching (QILT) Student Experience Survey (SES); not featured in mainstream global multi-faculty rankings such as QS World University Rankings or Times Higher Education due to being a specialized private higher education provider.
entry: Undergraduate programmes generally require Australian Year 12 completion (or international equivalent) with prerequisite senior mathematics and physics/chemistry, or a relevant VET qualification/diploma. Postgraduate master's degrees require a recognised Bachelor of Science (or Engineering) in a relevant field. English language proficiency requires IELTS Academic overall 6.0 (no band less than 5.5) for undergraduate and 6.0–6.5 for postgraduate programmes, or equivalent PTE/TOEFL scores. Acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. AUD 24,000–35,000 per year for international on-campus undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programmes; online undergraduate and master's degree courses range from approx. AUD 10,000–25,000 per year depending on study load, delivery mode, and degree level.

name: Universitas Nusa Putra
rank: Ranked #115 in Indonesia by Webometrics Ranking of World Universities (2024); ranked among the top 200 private universities in Indonesia by UniRank (2024).
entry: Completion of secondary education (SMA/SMK/MA or equivalent), submission of academic transcripts and identity documents, and passing the institutional entrance assessment/selection test (PMB Universitas Nusa Putra).
cost_shape: Approx. IDR 10,000,000–24,000,000 per year for domestic undergraduate programmes depending on the faculty, study programme, and admission scheme.

name: Regent University College of Science and Technology
rank: Ranked #18 in Ghana and #5,917 globally by Webometrics (Ranking Web of Universities, 2024); ranked #17 in Ghana by EduRank (2024).
entry: WASSCE/SSSCE certificate holders with credit passes (A1-C6 / A-D) in three core subjects including English and Mathematics, plus three elective subjects relevant to the chosen programme; GCE A-Levels (passes in three subjects plus O-Level credits in English and Mathematics); HND or equivalent diploma for top-up degree programmes; mature students (minimum 25 years old) passing an entrance examination.
cost_shape: Approx. GHS 6,000–12,000 per academic year for domestic undergraduate students; approx. USD 2,000–4,000 per academic year for international undergraduate students, varying by programme and study mode.

name: Wroclaw Akademia Biznesu
rank: Ranked among top non-public master's degree institutions in Poland by the Perspektywy University Ranking (typically within top 30 private HEIs).
entry: Secondary school leaving certificate (Matura or international equivalent) for bachelor's programmes; bachelor's degree diploma for master's programmes. Proof of English proficiency (e.g., B2 level via IELTS/TOEFL or internal assessment) for English-taught programmes or Polish proficiency for Polish-taught programmes; application form, passport copy, and CV/eligibility declaration.
cost_shape: Approx. PLN 5,500–8,500 per year for Polish-taught programmes; approx. EUR 2,000–3,500 per year for English-taught programmes for international students, depending on the programme and study level.

name: Atharva College of Engineering
rank: Ranked among top engineering colleges in Mumbai/Maharashtra by Times Engineering Survey; approved by AICTE and affiliated with the University of Mumbai, with NAAC accreditation.
entry: Admission to B.E. programmes requires 10+2 (HSC) with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects, plus a valid score in MHT-CET or JEE Main, followed by Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell Centralised Admission Process (CAP). Lateral entry requires a relevant engineering diploma or B.Sc. degree.
cost_shape: Approx. INR 1,20,000–1,40,000 per year for undergraduate engineering programmes under the Maharashtra Shikshan Shulka Samiti / Fee Regulating Authority norms.

name: Universidade Comunitária da Região de Chapecó - Unochapecó
rank: Ranked #145 in Brazil in the Folha University Ranking (RUF 2024); Ranked #201-250 in the QS Latin America University Rankings (Southern Cone / Regional editions historically).
entry: Admission to undergraduate programmes typically requires completion of secondary education (Ensino Médio) and qualification through the institutional entrance exam (Vestibular), National High School Exam (ENEM) scores, transfer, or previous higher education diploma. Postgraduate and specialised courses require relevant prior degrees and document review.
cost_shape: Approx. BRL 8,000–35,000 per year for standard undergraduate programmes depending on the field of study and credit load, with premium programmes such as Medicine having significantly higher fees (often exceeding BRL 100,000–140,000 per year).

name: West Herts College
rank: Rated 'Good' overall by Ofsted (UK Government inspection body for further education, verified); not featured in major global university league tables (e.g. QS, THE) as it is primarily a further education college delivering higher education qualifications in partnership with universities.
entry: For 16-18 and Level 3 vocational courses: typically requires 4-5 GCSEs at grades 9-4 (A*-C) including English Language and Mathematics, or relevant Level 2 qualification; Higher Education programmes (HNC/HND, Foundation Degrees) typically require relevant Level 3 qualifications or UCAS tariff points, alongside an interview or portfolio for creative subjects where applicable.
cost_shape: Tuition is free for UK/domestic students aged 16-18 on funded full-time courses; Higher Education programmes (HNC/HND/Foundation degrees) generally cost approximately £6,000–£8,500 per year for UK domestic students; fees vary for adult learners (19+) and international applicants depending on course level.

name: Bhagwan Parshuram Institute of Technology
rank: Ranked in the 251–300 band among Engineering institutions in India by NIRF (National Institutional Ranking Framework) 2022.
entry: Admission to B.Tech programmes is based on JEE Main scores followed by GGSIPU centralised counselling. Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with a minimum aggregate of 55%. Admission to MBA programmes requires a valid CAT, CMAT, or IPU CET score with an undergraduate degree with at least 50% marks.
cost_shape: Approx. INR 1,30,000 to 1,50,000 per year for B.Tech programmes (domestic tuition fee).

name: National Institute of Applied Sciences of Toulouse
rank: Ranked #1001-1200 globally in QS World University Rankings 2024 (as part of INSA Group/Federal University of Toulouse network); ranked among the top 10 French post-baccalaureate engineering schools by L'Etudiant (2023/2024); ranked in the 601-800 band for Engineering in Times Higher Education World University Rankings (2024).
entry: Admission for undergraduate engineering programmes (post-baccalaureate) is highly selective via the national Parcoursup platform and the Groupe INSA competitive process, based on high school academic records (scientific Baccalauréat or equivalent), grades in mathematics and physics/sciences, and an interview; admissions for master's/postgraduate and international degrees require a relevant bachelor's degree, academic transcripts, proof of French/English language proficiency (e.g., B2 level), and letters of recommendation.
cost_shape: Approx. €601 per year for EU/EEA students in standard national engineering diploma programmes; non-EU international students pay standard national French public university tuition rates or differentiated fees (approx. €601 to €3,770 per year depending on programme and waiver status), plus mandatory CVEC student life contribution (approx. €100-€103/year).

name: Centro Universitário de Brasília, UNICEUB
rank: Ranked #251-300 in QS Latin America University Rankings (2024).
entry: Completion of secondary education (Ensino Médio) or equivalent; admission via institutional entrance exam (Vestibular), national exam scores (ENEM), transfer, or holder of a previous higher education degree. Acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. BRL 10,000–30,000 per year for most undergraduate programmes, with Medicine significantly higher (approx. BRL 120,000–150,000 per year).

name: Kharkiv National University
rank: Ranked #691-700 in QS World University Rankings (2024); #1201-1500 in Times Higher Education World University Rankings (2024); ranked #2 nationally in Ukraine in Webometrics Ranking of World Universities (2023).

International applicants require a recognized secondary school diploma, academic transcripts, passport, and passing institutional entrance exams/interviews in the language of instruction or relevant subjects. English or Ukrainian language proficiency is required depending on the chosen medium of instruction; acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.

USD 1,800 to USD 4,500 per year (higher for medical programs, around USD 4,000–5,000 per year), excluding living expenses and medical insurance.

name: Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María
rank: QS World University Rankings 2024: ranked #801-850 globally and #41 in Latin America; Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2024: ranked #1001-1200 globally and #25 in Latin America; consistently ranked among the top engineering institutions in Chile.
entry: Admission to undergraduate programmes typically requires completion of secondary education (Licencia de Educación Media) and participation in the national university admission process (PAES/PDT), alongside high school grade ranking (NEM/Ranking). Specific score weighting varies by programme, with engineering degrees placing high emphasis on mathematics and science; acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. CLP 4,500,000 to CLP 6,500,000 per year for undergraduate programmes, depending on the specific degree and faculty. Eligible domestic students may access state gratuity (Gratuidad) and government loans/scholarships.

name: IÉSEG School of Management
rank: Ranked #32 globally in Financial Times Masters in Management Rankings (2023); Ranked #26 globally for Master in Management by QS Business Master's Rankings (2024); Ranked among top French post-baccalaureate business schools by L'Etudiant and Le Figaro.
entry: Admission requires a relevant secondary school diploma (for Bachelor/Grande École programme) or recognized undergraduate degree (for Master's/MSc programmes), academic transcripts, CV, motivation letter, English proficiency test scores (such as TOEFL, IELTS, or Cambridge), and an online interview or entrance examination (e.g. Concours ACCÈS for the Grande École programme in France).
cost_shape: Approx. €11,000–€13,500 per year for Bachelor/BBA programmes, €13,000–€15,000 per year for the Grande École Master in Management programme, and €17,000–€21,000 for specialized Master of Science (MSc) programmes (2023/2024 academic year).

name: Sun Yat-Sen University
rank: Ranked #73 globally in the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) 2023; #158 globally in the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2024; #319 globally in the QS World University Rankings 2024.

International undergraduate applicants require a high school diploma, academic transcripts, HSK Level 5 (score of 180+) for Chinese-taught programs or IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 85+ for English-taught programs, recommendation letters, and passing an institutional entrance examination or interview. Acceptance rate is highly competitive.
cost_shape: Domestic undergraduate tuition is approximately CNY 5,460–7,660 per academic year depending on the field of study. International undergraduate tuition is approximately CNY 26,000–48,000 per academic year depending on the program (e.g. higher for MBBS/Clinical Medicine).

name: Royal Holloway University of London
rank: Ranked #477 in QS World University Rankings 2025; ranked #301-350 in Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2024; ranked #29 in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2024.
entry: Undergraduate entry typically requires A-levels ranging from A*AA to BBB (or equivalent international qualifications like the International Baccalaureate). Specific subject prerequisites apply for certain degrees. English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS typically 6.0–6.5 overall, depending on course) is required for non-native speakers. Postgraduate entry generally requires a UK 2:1 or 2:2 honours degree or international equivalent.
cost_shape: For the 2024/25 academic year: UK undergraduate tuition is £9,250 per year. International undergraduate tuition typically ranges from approximately £20,000 to £26,500 per year depending on the course. Postgraduate tuition varies widely by programme (approx. £9,000–£15,000+ for UK students, £19,000–£28,000+ for international students).

name: Hunan University
rank: Ranked #418 globally in QS World University Rankings 2025; ranked #401–500 globally in Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2024; ranked #201–300 globally in Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) 2023.
entry: Undergraduate admission for domestic students requires completion of high school and qualifying scores on the National Higher Education Entrance Examination (Gaokao). International undergraduate applicants require a high school diploma, academic transcripts, proof of Chinese proficiency (HSK Level 4–5 for Chinese-taught programmes) or English proficiency (e.g. IELTS or TOEFL for English-taught programmes), and a physical examination record; acceptance rate is not publicly disclosed.
cost_shape: Approx. CNY 5,000–8,000 per year for domestic undergraduate students depending on major; approx. CNY 16,000–26,000 per year for international undergraduate students depending on field of study (e.g., liberal arts vs. engineering/sciences); excludes accommodation and living expenses.

name: University of Portsmouth
rank: Ranked #502 in QS World University Rankings 2025; Ranked #401–500 in Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2024; Ranked #33 in The Guardian University Guide 2024.
entry: Typical undergraduate entry requires A-levels (generally between 104 and 128 UCAS tariff points depending on the course), BTEC, or equivalent international qualifications. GCSE English and Mathematics at grade 4/C or above are typically required. International applicants generally require IELTS 6.0 overall (with no sub-score below 5.5) or equivalent. Some creative courses require a portfolio or interview.
cost_shape: For 2024/25: UK full-time undergraduate tuition is £9,250 per year. International undergraduate tuition generally ranges from £16,200 to £19,200 per year depending on the course. Postgraduate tuition varies by programme (approx. £9,000–£11,000 for UK students, and £17,200–£21,400 for international students).

name: Central Supélec
rank: CentraleSupélec is ranked #2 globally for Master in Engineering and #7 for Master in Data Analytics by QS World University Rankings 2024; ranked #1 in France for Engineering by L'Étudiant (2024); ranked #15 globally for Academic Reputation in Engineering & Technology as a founding constituent of Université Paris-Saclay in QS World University Rankings by Subject (2024).
entry: Admission to the Diplôme d'Ingénieur typically requires completing two years of Classes Préparatoires aux Grandes Écoles (CPGE) and passing the highly selective Concours Centrale-Supélec, or through the international student university track (CASTing / international dual degrees) requiring a bachelor's degree in science/engineering, academic transcripts, letters of recommendation, and English/French language proficiency.
cost_shape: Approx. €3,500 per year for EU/EEA students and approx. €12,000–19,000 per year for non-EU international students depending on the specific degree programme (Engineering Cycle or specialized Masters).

name: Marywood University
rank: Ranked #53 in Regional Universities North, #22 in Best Value Schools, and #37 in Top Performers on Social Mobility by U.S. News & World Report (2024).
entry: High school transcript, official SAT or ACT scores (optional for most undergraduate programs), letter of recommendation, and an essay/personal statement. Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo) required for international applicants. Specific programs like architecture, physician assistant, and music may require additional portfolios, auditions, or prerequisite coursework. Undergraduate acceptance rate is approximately 81%.
cost_shape: Undergraduate tuition is approximately $38,500–$40,000 per year (full-time undergraduate flat rate, excluding mandatory fees and room/board). Graduate tuition is charged per credit hour, typically ranging from $800 to $1,000 per credit depending on the program.

name: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies
rank: Ranked #801–850 in the QS World University Rankings 2025; ranked #148 in QS Asian University Rankings - Southern Asia 2024; ranked 42nd in the University category by NIRF 2024 (India).
entry: Undergraduate programmes generally require completion of 10+2 with a minimum aggregate (often 50%–60% depending on the course) and qualifying in entrance exams such as UPESEAT/JEE Main/SAT for Engineering, ULSAT/CLAT/LSAT for Law, or UPESDAT for Design, followed by personal interviews/portfolio reviews where applicable. Postgraduate programmes require a relevant Bachelor's degree and national/institutional exam scores (e.g., CAT, MAT, XAT, GATE, or UPESMET).
cost_shape: Approx. INR 2,50,000 to INR 6,00,000 per year for domestic undergraduate and postgraduate programmes depending on the discipline (e.g., higher for B.Tech, Design, and MBA programmes); additional fees apply for hostel and living expenses.

name: Ashoka University
rank: Ranked #1 private university in India by EducationWorld India Higher Education Rankings (2023–24); ranked #2 among private multi-disciplinary universities in India by India Today (2023).
entry: Holistic admissions process requiring completion of Class 12 / secondary education (or equivalent), Ashoka Aptitude Assessment (AAA) or standardized test scores (SAT/ACT), essays/statement of purpose, academic transcripts, extracurricular profile, and a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.
cost_shape: Tuition fees are approximately INR 8,000,000–9,50,000 per academic year for undergraduate programmes (excluding on-campus residence and meal charges; need-based financial aid available).

name: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City
rank: Ranked in the 101–150 band in the Engineering category by NIRF (National Institutional Ranking Framework) India 2024; ranked in the 101–150 band by NIRF Innovation 2023.
entry: Admission to B.Tech programmes requires completion of 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/relevant subjects, qualifying the JEE (Main) examination, and seat allocation through JoSAA/CSAB. M.Tech admissions require a relevant Bachelor's degree and qualifying GATE (allocated via CCMT). Ph.D. admissions require a Master's degree in a relevant discipline, written test, and interview.
cost_shape: Approx. INR 3,30,000 to INR 4,00,000 per year for B.Tech tuition (excluding hostel, mess, and one-time fees); approx. INR 2,00,000 to INR 2,50,000 per year for M.Tech tuition for domestic students.

name: Cégep de Saint-Jérôme
rank: Top 50 Research Colleges in Canada (ranked in Canada's Top 50 Research Colleges by Research Infosource in recent years, notable for its affiliated CCTTs CDCQ and IVI); specific global university ranking positions (QS/THE) are not applicable as it is a public general and vocational college (CEGEP).
entry: Quebec Secondary School Diploma (DES) or equivalent (DEP with required prerequisites), meeting specific program prerequisites (e.g., specific math or science courses for technical/pre-university profiles), French-language proficiency, and application submission via the Service régional d'admission du Montréal métropolitain (SRAM). International applicants require an equivalent secondary education diploma evaluated by SRAM.
cost_shape: Quebec resident Canadian citizens/permanent residents pay CAD 0 in basic tuition (approx. CAD 200–350 per semester in registration/student service fees). International student tuition ranges approximately from CAD 14,000 to CAD 20,000+ per year depending on the specific program (pre-university vs. technical).

name: Lindenwood University
rank: Ranked #392-#434 in National Universities by U.S. News & World Report (2024); Ranked #267 in Top Performers on Social Mobility by U.S. News & World Report (2024).
entry: Undergraduate admission requires high school diploma or GED transcript, with test-optional policy for ACT/SAT for most applicants. International applicants must provide proof of English proficiency (such as TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo). Acceptance rate is approximately 74% according to national reporting datasets.
cost_shape: Approx. USD 19,300–20,000 per year for full-time undergraduate tuition (2023–2024 academic year), excluding mandatory student fees, room, and board.

name: DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology
rank: Ranked in the 151–300 band in the NIRF Innovation category (2023); ranked among the top private engineering colleges in Punjab by various national media surveys such as CSR-GHRDC and Dataquest.
entry: For undergraduate engineering (B.Tech), requires 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science, and qualifying scores in JEE Main or merit-based selection via IKGPTU centralized counselling; postgraduate programmes (M.Tech, MBA, MCA) require a relevant bachelor's degree and qualifying exam scores (e.g., GATE for M.Tech, CMAT/merit for MBA).
cost_shape: Approx. INR 80,000–1,20,000 per year for B.Tech tuition fees (regulated as per I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University fee structure), excluding hostel, mess, examination, and other university charges.

name: Lovely Professional University
rank: NIRF 2023: Ranked 38th among all universities in India and 50th in the Overall category; Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2024: Ranked 801–1000 globally; QS World University Rankings 2024 (Southern Asia): Ranked 251–260.
entry: Undergraduate programmes typically require completion of 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with programme-specific subject minimums (often 50%–60% aggregate). Admission to major professional programmes (like B.Tech, MBA, LLB) requires qualifying the LPUNEST (National Entrance and Scholarship Test) or valid national exam scores (e.g., JEE Main, CUET, CAT, MAT, CLAT, NEET). Postgraduate programmes require a relevant Bachelor's degree and LPUNEST or national test qualification.
cost_shape: Approx. INR 1,00,000 to INR 3,20,000 per year (INR 50,000 to INR 1,60,000 per semester) for domestic students depending on the programme; international students pay approx. USD 3,000 to USD 6,000 per year, excluding accommodation and examination fees.

name: Sullivan University
rank: Ranked #137 in Regional Universities South by U.S. News & World Report (2024–2025); Sullivan University's College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences ranked #86 in Best Pharmacy Schools by U.S. News & World Report (2024).
entry: Requires a high school diploma, GED, or recognized equivalent, submission of official transcripts, and completion of an application for admission; specific programmes (such as Pharmacy, Nursing, and Physician Assistant studies) require programme-specific prerequisites, entrance assessments or licensure, background checks, and interviews. International students must demonstrate English language proficiency (e.g., TOEFL or IELTS). Acceptance rate is approximately 70–80%.
cost_shape: Approx. USD 14,000–16,000 per academic year for undergraduate programmes based on standard credit hour rates (approx. USD 420 per credit hour); graduate and professional programmes (such as Doctor of Pharmacy) vary from approx. USD 18,000 to over USD 45,000 per year.

name: Florida State College at Jacksonville
rank: Ranked #14 in Best Colleges in Florida by Niche (2024); Ranked #26 in Best Public Colleges in Florida by Niche (2024); Ranked #43 in Best Community Colleges in the United States by Academic Influence (2023).
entry: Open-access admissions policy for standard associate and certificate programmes (100% acceptance rate). Requirements include a standard high school diploma, GED, or home school verification, submission of official transcripts, and placement testing (PERT/ACT/SAT) or eligible exemptions. Selective admissions criteria apply to specific baccalaureate, nursing, and limited-access health science programmes, which may require minimum GPAs, prerequisite coursework, and entrance exams (e.g., TEAS). Proof of English proficiency (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo) required for international applicants.
